reviews.text: Kind and caring veterinarians and technicians. Wonderful dog care technicians. Always take time to answer my questions. Our dog loves going to dog care and has a great experience each time. We are very appreciative of the care given to our dog at appointments, grooming, dog care, and boarding.

I spoke with Katelyn over the phone she was extremely nice and went above and beyond to help me with my situation! She’s very patient and willing to help! Katelyn I truly appreciate your help today! You’re awesome!

Dr. Phillips, Dr. Williams, and Lindsay are all absolutely wonderful and flexible. All of the staff are very kind and professional. Our cat Chicken gets aggressive at the vet and they are very understanding and patient. Lindsay is a rockstar. We bring all of our cats here! They also wellness plans that cover yearly vet costs which is great.

I’ve seen Dr. Kessel for years and was so sad to hear she was no longer with the practice. I have a senior dog with a somewhat lengthy health history so it’s always nerve racking to start seeing someone new who may not have the full picture yet and/or who doesn’t know you personally. They ended up scheduling me with Dr. Jung and I could not recommend her enough. It was clear she took the time to read up on my dog’s history and she immediately made us both feel comfortable upon meeting her. She was kind, empathetic, and knowledgeable throughout our visit. It’s very clear she loves what she does, too. I will definitely bring my pup back to her.
They are very reassuring professionals.Top of the line care, I would recommend them for anyone that wants premium care for their pets
very good. Dr. William will be missed

They are extremely unable to understand what some people are going through, so they will take it out on your pet. No caring or support- it’s all about money. There are plenty of other vets in the area. Your pets deserve better.
Staff and Dr were great!
Called when my vet could not get my sick fur baby in and this group had us in within the hour and gave him exceptional care. Will be coming here from now on.
Old Town Animal care provides excellent care! We have 2 small dogs that manage to find their way to the vet and they receive the best care in Chicago from Old Town Dr Jung is outstanding
My dog needed an urgent appointment. He was seen the same day!
The best there is with pets. 15 out of 10.

Basil has been a 6year Patient of Dr. Kessel and the Old Town Animal Care Center. We have utilized the boarding facility and also Daycare.  Basil is very comfortable once he is there. They actually post pictures of him enjoying himself  with the staff. Basil loves human contact.  Basils immnunizations are always current always provide follow up care. So attentive always.
Old Town was extremely responsive, caring, thoughtful and they have a great selection of food in their store!

Went to this clinic since it was close. Staff seemed friendly and the Vet assigned to us was professional and informative. Overall experience was great for the visit.

Our dog had a mass that needed to be tested and the vet was honest with the options for testing. If it looked cancerous, further testing is suggested. Since the vet didn’t see it as such after extracting a small sample, a blood work test was recommended instead (seemed fair, since our dog is 14 years old).

When results came back ‘unremarkable’ as the vet puts it, she did mention our dog tested positive for Lyme. Although she recommended a precise test for assurance, again it seemed fair considering the my dog’s age.

When the staff called a couple days later to request payment for fecal matter testing and Lyme disease testing, that’s when something seemed off. At no point did the vet suggested any fecal matter test for parasites or worms during the initial visit nor the follow up call, let alone paying before the test was administered. Seems strange I would have to pay for a service I did not request nor informed about prior. I assume my dog would still have to come in and have blood drawn for the Lyme disease test should I agree to continue. What’s worse is the front desk didn’t allow my dog to be treated for the disease unless I agree to have her tested again.. citing the initial blood work could be a ‘false positive.’

So why would I pay over the phone before the test is performed? Also they didn’t send me the lab results until I requested it. Could improve in that regard.

Future costumers beware. If you are able to find a different clinic with no sudden service inclusions or up selling, probably best to go elsewhere.

The place is clean, and I’ve never had to wait long. The staff is very attentive and caring toward my senior dog, which I really appreciate. They take the time to explain everything thoroughly and make sure I understand what’s going on. I’m very happy with the care they provide!
Emma and Max are amazing!
Have 2 dogs who have been coming here since their first vet visit! Great staff who really care and are knowledgeable about pets!
I take my dog here. I like the staff and I think they are kind and courteous. I also have had a very good experience with their doctors including. Dr. Williams.

I’ve been going here since my dog was 8 weeks old, for over 8 years.  I try to book appointments early in the day so they are on time. The vets have been great.   Turnover of the front staff and over half of the vets seems pretty high, so I always wonder about that.   The year long packages are a good value, especially if you expect teeth cleaning that year. I have shopped around and verified the pricing.  I recommend this vet.
The vet was very nice and the place was clean and the staff was friendly.
Yearly wellness check was great! Very efficient, didn't have to wait, answered all my questions. Dr. Phillips was great!!

Was not happy with seeing Brandon Phillips, D.V.M.
He was extremely loud and talked very fast. Did not seem compassionate or say one word to my cat, which leads me to think that he’s in the wrong business. Seemed more concerned with other costly issues, than what I was originally having my cat seen for. The staff was nice. However, I just received an email saying that Dr. Kessel is leaving; my favorite veterinarian at the clinic.
Amazing vet! The staff here is wonderful.
The staff is fantastic.  We wouldn’t take our pups anywhere else.

Cannot say enough positive things about Dr. Sara Kessel. She truly cares about my animals and has gone above and beyond to investigate and treat with empathy and transparency. I am so lucky I found her and Old Town Vet:

Truly the best vet experience I could ever think to have! The staff is always super patient, knowledgeable, and willing to answer questions even over the phone/text.
The wellness plan they offer has also alleviated a lot of stress when it comes to going to the vet (for me lol) and it’s nice to know I just have to worry about covering that monthly rather than taking a huge hit with visits.
The team here and business itself is obviously invested in taking care of animals to the best of their ability, and truly demonstrates how much love they have for animals, making me feel comfortable leaving the care of my furry little one in their hands.
Big thank you to the team and business overall!
Was very pleased with the vets/staff and the overall facility. Everything you need in one place . Will be coming here permanently.
I have high praise for the vets and staff. They are friendly and caring for animals.

In the 3 years since adopting our shy cat Jessica, everyone at Old Town has always been kind, caring and responsive to her needs. Jess had been returned to the shelter twice due to her extreme shyness and  anxiety. I requested a shy cat knowing she was likely to be overlooked, and slowly she's working her way up to lap cat status! . My disabled son recently had a friend care for his cat, Kevin, when he couldn't. Sadly, Kevin was returned with a dreadlock. I went way too long for a nail trim for Jess, and she gained weight. Old town got them both in right away and updated shots as well. It's clear they love people as well as cats. I received no judgment, just professional care and compassion. We hope to stay with Old Town Animal Care for a long time!
Got an appointment quickly the doctor was terrific didn’t cost an arm and a leg. I liked the place would recommend it
I call for price to neuter my cat, and rep stated $700.. that is absolutely crazy...

Brought my sick kitty in as a new patient and had a great experience with Dr. Williams. Reasonably priced, attentive, and made me feel calmer about making a care plan for my little fur baby. I will be returning for continuing care.

We just moved to Chicago four days ago. Our sweet dog Johnny didn’t take the trip very well, got sick with diarrhea and wasn’t doing well. We have been a member of Banfield Clinic for 8 years but no location had an appt, one of the locations didn’t even answer the phone for two days, just an answering machine. We found Old Town Vet and couldn’t be more pleased. From the first phone call, the staff was so friendly and got us in same day. Dr. Lilja was attentive, thorough and kind. It is the first time ever that my dog didn’t shake like a leaf at the vet. His immediate needs were taken care of, his history and future care was addressed, and this is now our Vet.
They were extremely helpful and they helped my dog with her surgery she needed
Kala loves his visits here and they are amazing with him
Trust them completely with my dog. Make sure to verify info from front desk because I’ve gotten different answers before but they do an incredible job.
I’ve been going here for a few years, and my pet received very attentive care from friendly vets who answered all my questions.

I saw a new doctor today for my Shitzu. A new doctor to me, I am not sure how long this doctor has been with old town but the doctor was very helpful, informational and empathized with my thoughts on my babies issue worth taking the Bordetello vaccine. I am glad that the doctor mentioned a different way to administer this vaccine which my be less likely for my pretty to have a reaction. I had a great visit. Always worth the wait!!!
Really disappointing.  Bought their monthly plan, but had trouble getting an appointment after that.  I really regret taking my dog here.  They barely answer the phones.
Was just fine
Dr Plomin and the rest of the staff are terrific.
My directions were followed to the letter. The staff were lovely.  Poppy was boarded for four days without any problems or concerns. Highly recommend.
Thank you, Gregory. We love hearing that you and your pet enjoy visiting with us as much as we enjoy seeing you all! See you next time!

As first-time puppy parents, we couldn’t have asked for a better vet team. Everyone is so kind, patient, and genuinely cares about our puppy like she’s their own. They’ve made every visit such a positive experience and always make us feel supported as nervous dog parents. So grateful we found them 🤍
Great service. Real love for what they do and the animals they treat. Don’t ever change

Our dog Guinness loves going to daycare here!
The staff is always friendly, and we feel like he is genuinely in good hands when he visits for the day. We love watching the daily videos of him playing with his buds, and he always comes home worn out.
Our dog Zoey loves going to daycare here! She also receives her vet care here and I know she’s always in great hands.
They are so great to my puppy Blubell! And also very kind to the humans

The facility is really nice and the staff treat my dog like royalty. Dr. Kessel has helped me out a LOT with advice on being a first time dog owner- it's made the process so much easier. And everyone is very friendly- it almost doesn't even feel like a vet visit. Dash and I always look forward to our appointments!
Best groomer ever, Melanie! Highly recommend, no one grooms my dog as good as she does.
Great place for pet care took care of my dog just like a human thank you
I LOVE this place! The staff and doctors are so caring and always willing to go that extra step.  I take my cat and dog there as well as boarding! I know my pets are well taken care of!❤️
Staff is so helpful, caring, and professional. The Drs are so knowledgeable and explain everything clearly. I highly recommend this facility to anyone looking for outstanding care of their pet.
The staff is compassionate and kind.

We cannot say enough wonderful things about the staff at this clinic. Not only do they provide excellent veterinary care, but they also treat our dog like family at daycare. Every single person is so compassionate, patient, and attentive, and it gives us such peace of mind knowing she is loved and cared for when she’s there.

You can truly tell how much they care about the animals they work with. Our dog is always excited to go in and comes home happy, relaxed, and well cared for. We are so grateful for the kindness, professionalism, and genuine love they show every day. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet and daycare they can completely trust with their pet.

Words cannot describe how thankful we are to this veterinary hospital! Our baby kitten at 3 months old was diagnosed with epilepsy, and Dr. Jung has been so detailed oriented, strategic, and supportive with finding the right medicine dosage and best care to make his life as happy as possible. Their communication is excellent, and the staff is always more than happy to answer our questions. We could not ask for a better vet. We ❤️ Old Town

I have been bringing my dog Benji here since I first got him at 8 weeks old. He is now about to be 2 and every time we come here we always have the most positive experience! Everyone is so kind and helpful in every way. I’m so glad I have such a great vet so close to home!

I took my new puppy to Old Town Animal Care Center for the first time a couple weeks ago and the experience couldn’t have been better! They have a parking lot so it’s super easy to get in and out. I brought my historical forms and then they let me step out to walk him while they processed the forms. Once we went back to see the vet, they were very gentle and efficient with my dog and answered all of my questions and then some! We were able to get a bunch of vaccines for him and fairly quickly! They have lots of availability and are super friendly!

OTACC took care of my 20 year old pup until her very last day. They were EXTREMELY caring, attentive, through and I cannot recommend them more (especially for senior pets) Dr. Williams was our first visit and left such an impression that I knew that was the vet for us. From the doctors to the vet techs, not only do they have patience with the pets they see everyday but with the people too :)

The entire staff is friendly, helpful and professional. They go out of their way to accommodate and assist you. They took such great care of my dog Benson and were so patient with him while he was recovering (he's a bit of an escape artist). My dog loves going to the vet and he loves daycare. He is definitely in good hands. Highly recommend.

Just an update on my previous review - I have since used OTACC for boarding and it was also a great experience. My dog Benson is always happy there and well taken care of when I am out of town. I have no worries about him when I'm out of town! The entire staff is wonderful! strongly recommend!

Old Town Animal Care Center takes great care of my dog. We have been going here for four years for both minor and major health issues. I am always happy with the staff and they way they treat my pup. It is great to have them in the neighborhood!

I have been taking my cat here for about four years, and can say I fully trust them! Old Town Animal Care Center keeps my cat up to date on her shots and knew how to help when she got sick. Highly recommend this vet!

My dogs absolutely love this place. We take out dogs here for daycare, boarding and vet care for 2.5 years now. I can watch them through videos during playtime. They get the best care here. Staff is always so friendly and great with our dogs. I highly recommend Old Town Animal Care Center! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Dr. Jung & Old Town Animal Care Center have been a true Chicago treasure to find here here in the city and have far exceeded my expectations! Dr. Jung is so empathetic, reassuring and communicative. She has provided tremendous care for my senior pup during a few very scary medical emergencies and my pup came out on top every time due to her notch care. The clinic as a whole is quick to respond, always willing to squeeze us in and puts my nervous mama energy at ease. We feel so lucky to have found them!!

I can’t give enough stars or thanks to Old Town,  especially Dr. Kessel and the front desk team, each of whom is always kind, patient, professional and, most of all, profoundly caring to both the pets and the pet parents. From the bottom of my heart, thank you Old Town for always being there, caring for, and just loving my Shayna!! 🐾 💕💕 …
Friendly and knowledgeable, they always take care of my English bulldog

We absolutely love Dr. Sara Kessel! We’ve seen her a few times now, and every visit has been a great experience. She is incredibly thorough, personable, and you can tell she genuinely cares about the animals she treats. She always takes the time to answer all of my questions and never makes me feel rushed.

My dog is reactive, which can make vet visits stressful, but Dr. Kessel is so gentle and patient with him. She goes out of her way to make him feel comfortable, and it truly makes a difference in his experience. I’m so grateful we found her and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a compassionate and knowledgeable vet.
All the staff were incredibly caring and nice. The location was easy to access on North Ave with tons of parking available. They are also open on the weekend which is rare for nearby vet clinics.

Came in on a Sunday and had a really good experience at Old Town Animal Care Center. Dr. Eugene Jung was great, super professional but also really friendly and easy to talk to. The front desk staff was welcoming too, which made everything feel smooth from the start.
Very kind and on time, answered all my questions in advance with pricing.  Did not upsell services and helped with coordination of previous owner for my stray kitten.  Highly recommend.

One of my pups was a patient here for over five years. Over the years there were several doctors and staff that were comforting and kind to work with. However, doctor turnover seems really high. Just when I loved one, they would leave. More noteworthy, I have learned, through our new vet and research, that standard care protocol for dogs with liver shunts is regular urinalysis. This vet treated my pup with liver shunt(s) for over five years and never did urinalysis. The new vet did a urinalysis and we have nothing to compare it to, which is a significant issue for my pup's health considering her condition. There is no way to tell if her condition is worsening and the urinalysis is the single most important test for this. Other tests, such as bile acid and blood work, while pricier, are not nearly as important as the urine test. But they did the bile acid test and blood work regularly. I would not recommend this vet to a family member or a friend.

I've brought my pup in twice, but today was particularly noteworthy as I brought my dog in for an issue that turned out to be a little bit more serious than I had expected. Dr. Jung was wonderful and was very kind to me and my pup during the whole process. I felt like she listened to all my concerns, gave a thorough exam, and was very helpful in referring me to get further treatment for my pup. My pups and I will be back!
Always quick and very friendly with my fur baby
Always a great place to take your pet! Dr. Phillips is great!

Everyone was extremely friendly. My doggie had an issue where he had difficulty walking last week. The Vet checked him out and determined he probably had a back spasm. She massaged his back and corrected his knee imbalance. (She popped his knee back in) And he's been fine. She gave us some doggie ibuprofen, which he is, so far, tolerating well .. he's back to himself. Thank you!
Love this vet! We have been going her for years! They treat us and all of our pups with kindness and respect. It’s as expensive as most vets.
Thank you for your generous feedback, Shigeaki! Our team looks forward to seeing you and your pet again soon.

Nice people but EXTREMELY high prices. I have gone here for a couple years and they surprised me with a large price hike from the year prior without saying anything till after the check up. Typical private equity company price gouging of vet clinics. I will not be coming back.
Thank you for your amazing review, Ash! We love what we do and are glad to be here for you and your pet!
The negative reviews are laughable, they are all written by Karens. Dr. Jung is the best vet in the city and her intense attention to detail is very much appreciated!!
Very very overpriced. Vet acted as if I was boring her. Spoke in short clipped phrases. Have already looked into changing vets.

Thorough, compassionate and excellent care. Truly grateful to have been recommended to them. Always a great sign when another Dr recommends a specific business. Thank you Dr Jung and staff for your kindess and generosity to my cat.
The staff at Old Town Vet were very helpful and accommodating.

Dr. Kessel & the front desk staff are always amazing. They are very punctual with timing, try to get you in a room immediately, and it’s very clean and bright. We’ve been going to Dr. Kessel for about 2 years now and she’s always great with my anxious dog and not too in her space. She also is great when I ask to do blood draws and everything in the exam room instead of taking my dog to the back. She will explain testing and the processes in depth to me and has no issue answering my questions. We have since moved out of Chicago and to the suburbs, but will continue going to Old Town Animal Care Center. The pricing seems fair & in line with other Chicago vets.
This is the only place to take your pets! The staff and Doctors are amazing!
My experience was delightful, The Dr listened to my Concerns and answered all my questions, Thank You Dr. Tracy  and Old Town Animal Care Center. 🎈 …

I did not have a vet for my cat until the day before Christmas. My cat was ill and I was worried about leaving her for a few days. Old Town Animal Care was close by and agreed to see her. I was pleased with the service and the vet who examined her. All was well for me to leave town with no worries☺
Old Town Animal Care Center always provides excellent service and care to our 3 small dogs.
Our first visit to the center was great. The Vet and all staff were very friendly and professional. During the exam the doctor was kind and sensitive to us and our pet's needs.

Took my dog in on an emergency basis for what we know now is a dislocated patella.  The entire staff is wonderful. And it has a nicer feel compared to other offices.   I wish my own doctor explained things to me as well as Dr Lyons did.  We were well looked after.  I’m making them my regular vet.
Vet very attentive to pet owners. Explain everything to you in detail. They give you an estimate and you are able to make your own decision without being pushed.
Dr Kessel is very thorough. She did an excellent job in examining Rosie my 4 year old Snoodle . She explains exceptionally her full body examination. We love Dr Kessel

Dr. Kessel was ABSOLUTELY GREAT with both of my babies (male cats). They are of course cats so stand offish to begin with but Dr. Kessel was able to examine both of them with such easiness. As their owner I felt super comfortable and beyond happy to see them being well taken care of. We took on the snow storm to be able to see Dr. Kessel and the team and super happy we did. Fabulous and the reason we come back for their care here.

I have had a great experience with the staff and vets (Dr Lyons & Dr Kessel)! I am grateful for the thorough care we have received. They are fantastic at providing education. I appreciate the weekend appointments as it can be hard to fit appointments in on the week days. I would recommend Old Town Animal Care Center to all.

Friendly staff, did a great job grooming my Aussies! We have been to a few groomers since moving to Chicago, NONE did as good a job, and cost was below what we expected. Felt like the dogs were well cared for with initial visit with the Vet as well!!

While grooming is excellent, getting an appointment for my sick dog is disappointingly difficult and their claim to offer “urgent care” appointments is laughable. Like every vet office, the front desk staff is unhelpful, smarmy, and condescending… hint… you are not a vet, stop thinking you possess some magical knowledge because you answer the phone.

I will be looking for a clinic that can actually care for my animal when we need it rather than simply over charge us for vaccines. Old town. You are a teal disappointment.
We just recently moved to Chicago with our 3 dogs. We are very happy to have a great vet close by. They are very detailed and responsive. All of our dogs enjoyed the first visit.
Staff is super friendly and knowledgeable regarding all our puppy inquiries! As first time puppy owners, we feel very at ease after the visit.
Great vet for my cats!
dr. Williams is the best she’s amazing with my little 6 pound Yorkie. I’ve been taking him there since he’s been a baby. I guess I should say puppy lol

The staff is great, standard of care is excellent. Highly recommend.    Only down side is that they more or less force you to use their online pharmacy which is just awful to deal with. Truly terrible

This is where you want your babies to be seen. They are welcoming and loving and my dog who has really bad anxiety feels comfortable here at Old Town Animal Care Center. Lindsay the technician was absolutely amazing and took great care of my dog, answered all my questions and kept me updated with everything. We saw her yesterday and she was just an absolute pleasure. She went above and beyond to help and answer all the questions I had even though I can tell she was super busy. Lindsay you are the best! OTACC we love you guys! Thank you for your service always!

Lindsey is an amazing tech! We’re going through a tough time with our senior dog and really appreciated her direct communication during this. She’s the perfect mix of being all business while also caring passionately for those she treats!
I’ve really appreciated all the help and services I’ve received from Old Town Animal Care. The staff has always been friendly and compassionate. I highly recommend.

A really good vet that provides good customer service at market rates and takes good care of your pets. This is a good clinic that provides great services. It's worth noting that it's not a budget clinic and located in one of the more weathier areas of the city of Chicago. If budget is a huge area of concern, this place is probably not a good place to make a regular resource. But if you have the means, it's a great option. They accept care credit and offer monthly pet plans. The only thing I would suggest is it would be helpful to offer a bundle discount or add on discount for multiple pet households for their subscription plan. I have 2 cats and it makes no sense to buy the same plan for 2 cats at the same price.  I would totally subscribe if I could add a second animal at a reduced rate. That way would ensure loyalty to the center, even if they had to add co-pays to the plan. But every time I took my cats to this place they take such good care of them. I trust my fur babies completely there.
Staff is so nice and friendly. Very welcoming and I feel comfortable with them.
Staff took great care of my two wonderful kittens! Highly recommend!

We have been taking our fur babies here for 10 years. We truly don’t have any issues with them. They only issue we have is at times when we need to set up an appointment for urgent care , they don’t have availabilities at times . They have accommodations dated us based on severity and we really appreciate that. We live over an hour and half away so it’s difficult to travel at times there but we keep coming back because they are pretty good and in the suburbs vet clinics don’t have wellness programs. You have to get pet insurance which can get costly.
Old Town is the best.  They respond immediately to any questions.
Very rude.....very unprofessional....Don’t trust them with your love ones.
The staff at Old Town is wonderful and we're very happy with their Boarding facility.  Most important, our little Spike is especially happy there, and that means everything!
We Love it here, everyone is always so helpful and supportive. Been a client for 5 years always on top of everything.

Been going here for my cockapoo since 2019. I have consistently had positive experiences and interactions during my wellness checkups and issue visits. I felt like the technicians, front desk and vets all had professional and empathetic demeanors. More than that, I trust their care for our pup. They find the right balance between making sure we are doing what our dog needs to be healthy, happy and comfortable without pushing too much extra or guilting us into more that we need.
We use their pet care plans and it has been consistent money up front but has saved us money in the long run and pricing feels fair overall.

Their wellness plan is the biggest scam ever, all their prices are jacked up to make it seem like their wellness plan is a good deal. Tried to get her off the wellness plan today and was charged 185 for three vaccines because she has to renew the whole yearly plan to get the vaccine covered by plan. This was not communicated to us ahead and we thought it’d be part of her plan, and we were forced to pay cuz she already got her vaccine when we were notified of the charge.

We’ve been customers of Old Town Animal Care Center for a while now and have always had good experiences, but when we brought our dog Bella in recently to treat an emergency wound the care she received was unparalleled. Lindsey was the tech who took care of us and she did such a fantastic job making sure Bella was comfortable and not scared and went above and beyond to ensure we were equipped to continue treating her wound at home. Our vet, Dr. Vaziri, was also lovely, attentive to detail, and thorough in explaining all of her observations and recommended course of treatment. Bella was a rescue and has a history of abuse so is very anxious; both Lindsey and Dr. Vaziri went out of their way to make sure they didn’t spook her and were incredibly patient with her. Thank you both!
Thank you for your amazing review, Gary! We love what we do and are glad to be here for you and your pet!

I’ve had yet to have a bad experience while visiting. My pup has been going to Old Towne since he was born. He’s now 4. The entire staff is nice. My last visit I was greeted with a warm welcome from Katelynn! Sarah assisted us with checking out. Both ladies were awesome!!
Thank you for your amazing review, Nancy! We love what we do and are glad to be here for you and your pet!
Best groomer and best staff.  Snow loves it there.
Thank you for your generous feedback, Brooke! Our team looks forward to seeing you and your pet again soon.

We’ve taken our cat here since they first opened and have always had great experiences. Every vet has been so thorough and caring. Also, want to give a special shoutout to Sarah at the front desk who always goes out of their way to make sure our little Sophie cat is taken care of and everything is explained to us!

I cannot say enough good things about this place. I rushed my dog here last week after she was displaying some breathing issues as I mistakenly thought it was an ER clinic. The front desk checked to see if the vet could fit me in and she kindly obliged. Everyone was SO accomodating and I instantly felt like my dog was in good hands. They identified a few issues, but I found their prices to be quite reasonable. As a first time dog mom, they give me peace of mind which you can't put a price on. I highly recommend!!
Excellent veterinarian, and kennel.
The vets here are awesome. They are really good with my cats.

I've been bringing my pets to Old Town for over 8 years and I have always felt well taken care of by the team.  In fact, 4 years ago I moved closer to the south Loop and I still travel to take my pets to Old Town.

I was able to bring our dog in same day. Dr Williams was very good about updating me as soon as possible and shared costs with me. We were able to pick him up a little over 2 hours later. Otto is taking his meds and slowly getting better.
One star off because I hated having to drop him off and leave - never got to meet the vet and it was expensive.
Dr. Williams really listened to our concerns about our dog Nugget's pain, and she helped develop a treatment plan that seems to be helping already.

Our dog has health issues and they always take great care of him when doing nails. The nail technician was especially helpful and I would highly recommend this clinic. We have been going here for years. Love this place and all the workers are amazing.
I’m always impressed with Old Town Animal Care. Everyone from the front desk to the doctor are always very compassionate and friendly. I would and have recommended them to friends and family!

I can never thank OTACC enough for their care and love when we had to make the difficult decision of end of life care for our senior Dane. OTACC was with us every step of the way. From creating an initial plan so that we could have a few more months with our boy, to visits, and phone calls to make sure we were doing ok with medication. The day we made the decision, they assured us we would have a standing appointment for whenever we were ready. The staff cared for our family like their own and gave us as much time as we needed, never rushing us. They are true professionals here.

Friendly, quick and efficient.  I also love that their bathroom is always clean and they have coffee and water available.  The tech we had was super high energy:/enthusiastic and my dog had no clue he was about to get a shot 🤣 …
We have been happy with the help, guidance, and availability.
Thank you for the great feedback! We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience at Old Town Animal Care Center and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet.
Thank you for your generous review! We appreciate your feedback and hope to see you again soon!
Tons of availability when other vets are booked.  Wonderful staff, friendly and knowledgeable.  Would greatly recommend!
I love the Clinic, they always take great care of my girl Lucy.

Edited to reflect new experiences -- I left Old Town Animal Care Center about a year ago after a few different incidents but the big one being the distress my dog was in whenever visiting. My dog had gone to OTACC for regular anal gland expressions -- 1x every 2-3 months. It turns out my dog had been in significant distress during these visits and it was NEVER communicated to me. This had gone on for more than two years. I was only made aware of it after reviewing the care notes I stumbled upon after requesting her full medical history with the office (which was a pain to get them to even send to me; however they had no issues sending her full history to her pet insurance company without my consent). During her anal gland expressions, she had been muzzled (which is perfectly fine!! please keep the staff safe! please keep my dog safe!) however this was never brought to my attention, and it turns out my dog was in serious distress during her visits but I was never made aware. I recommend anyone bringing their pet here to make sure they know what's going on when they take your pet to the back for care. My dog now attends a fear-free vet clinic. I'm thankful I can now be in the room while she receives care (and she now does JUST fine with her anal gland expressions).

I’ve been taking my dog to daycare here for five years. Daycare is fine. But you better pick up your dog before close because they don’t call to remind you of the closing time and if you’re past it, they board your dog without telling you and there’s no one to reach until they open up the next morning.  When I dropped him off in the morning for daycare, I said I’m not sure if I will be a half-day or full day for daycare and at that time I should’ve been told that they close at 3 PM on Saturdays as a reminder.  You need to know about the boarding process.   There is absolutely NOONE there overnight with the dogs from closing time until opening time.  I was told that there is video footage, but that no one looks at it to supervise that the dogs are OK unless there is a catastrophe that they find out about the next morning when they come in.   My dog was left alone from 3 PM on Saturday until about 8 PM on Sunday with ZERO supervision - they couldn’t tell me if he was fed, what time he was fed or if he ate.  I know he didn’t eat because he scarfed the equivalent of two meals down within the first few minutes of getting home.  What kind of vet care would/should have practices like this?   After the vet and daycare service is closed for the day at 3 PM, there is no one to reach. No phone number to call.  No one to be found. Just your precious, priceless pet alone unsupervised.  Shameful!!!! When I came in the next Morning to pick him up, all of these things were confirmed by the weekend manager.  I asked to see the video footage and was told she doesn’t have access to it and that I need to talk to the head manager tomorrow. I was very upset and used a swearword and the reply from her was “I’m not going to be disrespected and I’m going to ask you to leave.”   Status with the head manager calling me tomorrow is to be determined tomorrow.  BE FOREWARNED not to board your pet here.   I recommend Urban Pooch where they have multiple people in the rooms with the dogs 24/7, like it should be.
Final outcome: The manager called me six days later to discuss what happened and ended the phone call having the gall to ask me not to come back there because I gave a negative review.  (Not that I would have!). And you’ll see the response below that’s the same response that they give everyone.
